skill.name: product-feed-optimizer
skill.description: Audit and improve Shopping and Performance Max product feeds by identifying disapprovals, missing attributes, and inaccurate product data.
skill.summary: Improve product-feed quality before publishing Shopping or Performance Max campaigns.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: All 52 static findings are false positives: Markdown links, Markdown code formatting, metadata URLs, and GTIN guidance were misclassified as dangerous behavior. One semantic issue remains: the user-derived segment in the optional save filename lacks an explicit path-sanitization requirement. The skill otherwise instructs agents to treat feed data as untrusted and avoids inventing product data.

remediation.issue: The optional save filename includes a user-derived catalog-or-goal segment without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Normalize the segment to a fixed allowlist such as lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; reject separators, dot segments, and absolute paths before writing.

content.value_statement: Product feed errors can block ads and reduce product visibility. This skill creates a structured remediation plan for attributes, disapprovals, titles, and listing groups.
actual_capabilities: Identifies likely causes and fixes for product disapprovals from supplied diagnostics.
Checks required and recommended feed attributes for each product item.
Rewrites product titles using front-loaded, truthful attribute patterns.
Flags GTIN, availability, and price mismatches against supplied source data.
Proposes listing-group or asset-group structures using real feed segments.
Marks missing facts for follow-up instead of inventing product data.
limitations: It needs a feed export, diagnostics, or product details supplied by the user.
It does not access Merchant Center or publish feed changes automatically.
It cannot verify live landing pages or inventory without user-provided access or evidence.
It provides recommendations and does not guarantee platform approval or campaign performance.

use_cases.title: Resolve catalog disapprovals
use_cases.description: Triage Merchant Center diagnostics into item-level causes, fixes, and unresolved questions.

use_cases.title: Prepare a new Shopping feed
use_cases.description: Review required attributes and product titles before launching a Shopping or Performance Max campaign.

use_cases.title: Standardize catalog data
use_cases.description: Create repeatable title and attribute conventions across product categories and variants.

prompt_templates.title: Check missing attributes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this product feed excerpt. List missing required attributes for each item and mark facts that need a source.

prompt_templates.title: Triage disapprovals
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Merchant Center diagnostics export and feed file. Create an item-by-item table with the disapproval cause, evidence, and recommended fix.

prompt_templates.title: Improve product titles
prompt_templates.prompt: Rewrite these product titles using truthful front-loaded attributes. Preserve real brand, model, size, color, and product facts.

prompt_templates.title: Plan feed-driven campaign groups
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this approved product feed for Performance Max. Propose listing groups based on real product type, brand, and custom-label segments, with risks noted.

output_examples.input: A feed item has an empty GTIN and a price that differs from its landing page.
output: Cause: missing identifier and price mismatch.
Action: request the real GTIN and reconcile the price with the landing page.
Status: hold the item until the source facts are confirmed.

output_examples.input: A title reads: SALE Best Running Shoes Free Shipping.
output: Suggested title: Brand Running Shoe, followed by verified model, material, color, and size.
Remove promotional language from the title.
Verify that color and size match their dedicated feed attributes.

best_practices: Provide a recent feed export and the matching disapproval report.
Use landing-page facts as the source for price and availability checks.
Review proposed changes before publishing them to an advertising platform.
anti_patterns: Do not invent GTINs, prices, stock counts, brands, or product specifications.
Do not use promotional claims, emojis, or unsupported superlatives in product titles.
Do not treat a rewritten title as a substitute for resolving a disapproval.

faq.question: What files should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a TSV, CSV, or XML feed export and, when available, a diagnostics or disapproval export.

faq.question: Can it fix Merchant Center disapprovals?
faq.answer: It identifies likely causes and proposes fixes. You review and apply the changes in your feed system.

faq.question: Will it create GTINs for missing products?
faq.answer: No. It marks missing identifiers for source verification and does not invent GTINs.

faq.question: Does it change my live catalog?
faq.answer: No. The skill produces recommendations and does not publish changes automatically.

faq.question: Can it help with Performance Max campaigns?
faq.answer: Yes. It can propose feed-driven listing groups or asset groups based on real catalog segments.

faq.question: Does it guarantee approval or better ROAS?
faq.answer: No. Platform policies, landing pages, inventory, and account settings affect approval and performance.
